data.name: SUGA: Survival Game
data.detailed_description:
SUGA is a 2D Top-down pixel-styled survival game, set in a post-apocalyptic future, wherein you battle an assortment of enemies through the nights, and by plundering the world of it's wildlife and natural resources to build a mega-awesome base with up to four friends (or frenemies, as it may well be).

Fight through unique bosses and mini-bosses to unlock new resources and areas, alongside a plethora of new technologies to batter those pesky zombies with! Explore uniquely generated worlds and structures in this silly, whimsical 2D game being developed by a group of mates since 2023.

Key Features

  • Simple Multiplayer for up to 5 Players

  • Unique Procedural World and Structure Generation

  • Dynamic Weather

  • Character Customisation

  • 5 Unique Bosses

  • Expansive Crafting System including Alloys and Farming

  • Grid-Based Modular Base Building

  • Bill

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3250U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Does run on an Intel Atom. Please don't.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-1235U
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris XE
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
